description: Source code for the scheduled post API endpoints in Mattermost, including creation, update, deletion, and retrieval of scheduled posts, with permission checks and validation.

methods.name: InitScheduledPost
methods.description: Initializes API routes for scheduled post operations: create, update, delete, and get team scheduled posts.

methods.name: scheduledPostChecks
methods.description: Performs permission and validation checks on a scheduled post before processing.

methods.name: requireScheduledPostsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if scheduled posts feature is enabled and licensed.

methods.name: createSchedulePost
methods.description: Handles creation of a new scheduled post, including permission checks, validation, and saving.

methods.name: getTeamScheduledPosts
methods.description: Retrieves scheduled posts for a specific team, with optional inclusion of direct channels.

methods.name: updateScheduledPost
methods.description: Updates an existing scheduled post after validation and permission checks.

methods.name: deleteScheduledPost
methods.description: Deletes a scheduled post after verifying permissions.
